design_detail: wealth tax on large asset owners raising ~Rp 81.6T
quote_original: Menaikkan PPN menjadi 12% mungkin terlihat sebagai solusi cepat, tapi sebenarnya ada jalan yang lain. Satu, terhadap pajak kekayaan yang menarget mereka yang memiliki aset besar bisa menghasilkan kurang lebih Rp 81,6 triliun. Ini mengurangi ketimpangan tanpa membebani kelompok miskin.
quote_en: Raising VAT to 12% may seem like a quick fix, but there is actually another way. First, a wealth tax targeting those who hold large assets could generate approximately IDR 81.6 trillion. This reduces inequality without burdening the poor.
source_title: Ganjar Usul Kejar Pajak Orang Kaya daripada Naikkan PPN, Bisa Dapat Rp 81 T!
grading_note: Grade A: explicitly proposes a wealth tax targeting large asset owners (citing Rp 81.6T yield) as an alternative to a VAT hike.

design_detail: wealth tax on assets of 100 richest individuals
quote_original: Ini lebih menuju yang istilahnya wealth tax. Kita harus pajaki hartanya, bukan penghasilannya, karena ini lebih ke isu ketimpangan harta ketimbang penghasilan.
quote_en: This is more towards what is called a wealth tax. We have to tax their wealth, not their income, because this is more of an issue of wealth inequality rather than income.
source_title: Anies Mau Pajaki Orang Kaya, Begini Aturan Pajak Kekayaan RI
grading_note: Grade A: explicitly defines the AMIN campaign proposal as a wealth tax targeting the stock of wealth of the 100 richest people.

design_detail: wealth tax on the 100 richest individuals
quote_original: Calon presiden dan wakil presiden nomor urut 1 Anies Baswedan-Muhaimin Iskandar menyatakan ingin memajaki 100 orang paling kaya di Indonesia. Muhaimin dalam debat cawapres menyatakan pajak ini dapat menjadi solusi dalam mengatasi ketimpangan di Indonesia.
quote_en: Presidential and vice-presidential candidate pair number 1 Anies Baswedan-Muhaimin Iskandar stated that they want to tax the 100 richest people in Indonesia. Muhaimin in the vice presidential debate stated this tax can be a solution to address inequality in Indonesia.
source_title: Anies Mau Pajaki Orang Kaya, Begini Aturan Pajak Kekayaan RI
grading_note: Grade A: formal policy platform proposal to levy wealth tax on the assets of the top 100 richest people. Review: regraded A to B: named in a campaign report, not own words.

design_detail: wealth tax on the 100 richest individuals
quote_original: Muhaimin dalam debat cawapres menyatakan pajak ini dapat menjadi solusi dalam mengatasi ketimpangan di Indonesia.
quote_en: Muhaimin in the vice presidential debate stated that this tax can be a solution in addressing inequality in Indonesia.
source_title: Anies Mau Pajaki Orang Kaya, Begini Aturan Pajak Kekayaan RI
grading_note: Grade A: announced during official vice-presidential debate to tax the wealth of the 100 richest individuals. Review: regraded A to B: reported by a news outlet, not own words.

design_detail: wealth tax on the super-rich to narrow inequality
quote_original: Fenomena ini jelas menunjukkan adanya ketidakadilan distribusi. Karena itu, pajak kekayaan menjadi instrumen yang patut dipertimbangkan untuk mempersempit ketimpangan.
quote_en: This phenomenon clearly shows an injustice in distribution. Therefore, a wealth tax is an instrument worth considering to narrow inequality.
source_title: PKS Dorong Kajian Serius Penerapan Pajak Kekayaan untuk Redam Ketimpangan Sosial
grading_note: Grade B: supports wealth tax (pajak kekayaan) by name on behalf of PKS leadership.

design_detail: 2% on assets of the super rich / top 50 billionaires
quote_original: Jadi kalau pemerintah ingin agar kelas menengah daya belinya terjaga, rasio pajaknya meningkat, maka saatnya 2% dari aset orang-orang super kaya itu dikenakan pajak.
quote_en: So if the government wants the purchasing power of the middle class to be maintained and the tax ratio to increase, then it is time for 2% of the assets of the super-rich to be taxed.
source_title: Momentum Mendesak, Pajak Kekayaan Dinilai Solusi Redam Ketimpangan Ekonomi
grading_note: Grade A: specifically advocates a 2% annual tax on the net assets of the super-rich.

design_detail: 2% tax on assets of the super rich
quote_original: Selain itu pajak kekayaan berupa 2 persen pajak bagi aset orang super kaya merupakan hal yang urgen dilakukan untuk menekan ketimpangan, sekaligus memperbesar penerimaan negara.
quote_en: In addition, a wealth tax in the form of a 2 percent tax on the assets of the super-rich is an urgent step to curb inequality, while increasing state revenues.
source_title: 5 PR Utama Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa sebagai Menteri Keuangan Baru
grading_note: Grade A: explicit recommendation to new Finance Minister for a 2% wealth tax on super-rich assets.

design_detail: 2% wealth tax on 50 richest individuals or progressive 1-2% on net worth > Rp 84B
quote_original: Sebagai solusi, CELIOS mengusulkan penerapan pajak kekayaan (wealth tax) sebesar 2 persen bagi individu yang memiliki kekayaan di atas Rp84 miliar. Berdasarkan perhitungan lembaganya, kebijakan tersebut berpotensi menghasilkan penerimaan negara sekitar Rp140 triliun setiap tahun.
quote_en: As a solution, CELIOS proposes the implementation of a wealth tax of 2 percent for individuals with assets over IDR 84 billion. Based on institutional calculations, this policy has the potential to generate state revenue of around IDR 140 trillion annually.
source_title: Soroti Ketimpangan, Media Askar Usulkan Pajak Kekayaan, Nilainya Tembus Rp 140 Triliun
grading_note: Grade A: institutional proposal recommending 2% wealth tax on net assets above Rp 84 billion.

design_detail: wealth tax on the ultra-rich to curb extreme inequality
quote_original: Direktur Kebijakan Publik Celios, Media Wahyudi Askar menjelaskan, dari studi yang dilakukan, jika pajak kekayaan dikenakan hanya pada 50 orang terkaya di Indonesia dengan tarif 2% dari total kekayaan mereka, potensi penerimaan negara mencapai Rp 81,56 triliun setiap tahun.
quote_en: Celios Public Policy Director, Media Wahyudi Askar explained that from their study, if a wealth tax was levied only on the 50 richest individuals in Indonesia at a 2% rate of their total wealth, state revenue potential would reach IDR 81.56 trillion each year.
source_title: Momentum Mendesak, Pajak Kekayaan Dinilai Solusi Redam Ketimpangan Ekonomi
grading_note: Grade A: published op-ed in Kompas arguing that wealth taxation is rational and urgent, countering opponents.

design_detail: 2% wealth tax on assets > Rp 84B
quote_original: Sebagai solusi, CELIOS mengusulkan penerapan pajak kekayaan (wealth tax) sebesar 2 persen bagi individu yang memiliki kekayaan di atas Rp84 miliar. Berdasarkan perhitungan lembaganya, kebijakan tersebut berpotensi menghasilkan penerimaan negara sekitar Rp140 triliun setiap tahun.
quote_en: As a solution, CELIOS proposes the implementation of a wealth tax of 2 percent for individuals with wealth above IDR 84 billion. Based on calculations, this policy has the potential to produce state revenues of around IDR 140 trillion each year.
source_title: Soroti Ketimpangan, Media Askar Usulkan Pajak Kekayaan, Nilainya Tembus Rp 140 Triliun
grading_note: Grade A: testimony and presentation at DPR RI Nusantara V building presenting a 2% wealth tax proposal.

design_detail: 2% wealth tax on ultra-high-net-worth individuals
quote_original: Center of Economic and Law Studies (Celios) menilai saat ini merupakan momentum yang tepat bagi pemerintah untuk segera menerapkan pajak kekayaan. ... Dalam laporan berjudul "Dengan Hormat, Pejabat Negara: Jangan Menarik Pajak Seperti Berburu di Kebun Binatang", Celios mengungkapkan bahwa saat ini Indonesia belum menerapkan pajak kekayaan secara progresif.
quote_en: Center of Economic and Law Studies (Celios) assessed that this is the right momentum for the government to immediately implement a wealth tax. ... In the report titled "Respectfully, State Officials: Do Not Collect Taxes Like Hunting in a Zoo", Celios stated that Indonesia has not yet implemented a progressive wealth tax.
source_title: Momentum Mendesak, Pajak Kekayaan Dinilai Solusi Redam Ketimpangan Ekonomi
grading_note: Grade A: co-author of CELIOS research proposal on 2% wealth tax.

design_detail: wealth tax on super rich as redistribution
quote_original: Senada, Direktur Eksekutif Institute for Development of Economics and Finance (INDEF), Esther Sri Astuti mendorong pemerintah menerapkan pajak kekayaan kepada kelompok super kaya sebagai bentuk redistribusi dan penurunan ketimpangan sosial ekonomi. "Subsidi silang yang kaya bayar pajak lebih mahal untuk memperbanyak fasilitas publik untuk yang tidak mampu," kata Esther dalam diskusi INDEF, Senin (1/9/2025).
quote_en: Similarly, Executive Director of the Institute for Development of Economics and Finance (INDEF), Esther Sri Astuti encouraged the government to implement a wealth tax on the super-rich as a form of redistribution and reduction of socio-economic inequality. "Cross-subsidy: the rich pay higher taxes to increase public facilities for those who cannot afford it," said Esther in an INDEF discussion, Monday (1/9/2025).
source_title: Desakan Pajak Kekayaan Menguat, Diyakini Bisa Memperkecil Ketimpangan
grading_note: Grade B: supports wealth tax (pajak kekayaan) on the super-rich by name in an INDEF policy discussion.

design_detail: wealth tax on the super rich for fiscal redistribution
quote_original: Senada, Direktur Eksekutif Institute for Development of Economics and Finance (INDEF), Esther Sri Astuti mendorong pemerintah menerapkan pajak kekayaan kepada kelompok super kaya sebagai bentuk redistribusi dan penurunan ketimpangan sosial ekonomi.
quote_en: Similarly, Executive Director of the Institute for Development of Economics and Finance (INDEF), Esther Sri Astuti urged the government to apply a wealth tax to the super rich as a form of redistribution and reduction of socioeconomic inequality.
source_title: Desakan Pajak Kekayaan Menguat, Diyakini Bisa Memperkecil Ketimpangan
grading_note: Grade B: institutional forum and executive endorsement of wealth taxation.

design_detail: wealth tax on high net worth individuals & super rich
quote_original: PWYP Indonesia bersama aliansi Forum Pajak Berkeadilan Indonesia (FPBI) melalui White Paper Reformasi Pajak 2025 menyerukan agar reformasi pajak mencakup tiga pilar utama: (1) perluasan basis pajak progresif, termasuk pajak kekayaan dan pajak karbon; (2) penguatan administrasi dan penegakan hukum perpajakan; serta (3) peningkatan transparansi dan partisipasi publik dalam perumusan kebijakan fiskal.
quote_en: PWYP Indonesia together with the Indonesian Fair Tax Forum (FPBI) alliance through the 2025 Tax Reform White Paper called for tax reform to cover three main pillars: (1) expansion of the progressive tax base, including wealth tax and carbon tax; (2) strengthening of tax administration and law enforcement; and (3) increasing transparency and public participation in fiscal policy formulation.
source_title: Forum Pajak Berkeadilan Indonesia Serukan Reformasi Pajak untuk Keadilan Pajak dan Ekonomi
grading_note: Grade A: coalition published formal white paper explicitly proposing net wealth tax expansion.

design_detail: progressive 1-2% on net wealth > Rp 140B
quote_original: Implementasi pajak kekayaan atau pajak untuk orang kaya semakin menemukan relevansinya. Pajak kekayaan bisa menjadi salah satu instrumen yang potensial dalam redistribusi kekayaan, mengatasi ketimpangan, serta menambah penerimaan negara.
quote_en: The implementation of a wealth tax or tax on the wealthy is finding increasing relevance. A wealth tax can be a potential instrument in wealth redistribution, tackling inequality, and augmenting state revenues.
source_title: PB 35 – Pajak Kekayaan: Menakar Potensi dan Peluang Implementasi di Indonesia
grading_note: Grade A: institutional research policy brief recommending a 1-2% progressive wealth tax.

design_detail: 1% annual wealth tax on net worth > Rp 140B
quote_original: Warga superkaya yang total kekayaan bersih lebih dari Rp140 miliar setahun dapat disasar dengan membayar pajak kekayaan 1 persen dari total hartanya.
quote_en: Super-rich citizens whose total net wealth exceeds IDR 140 billion a year can be targeted by paying a wealth tax of 1 percent of their total assets.
source_title: Penerapan Pajak Kekayaan bagi Orang Superkaya Dinilai Jadi Solusi Pulihkan Ekonomi
grading_note: Grade A: explicit proposal specifying a 1% annual tax on net assets above Rp 140 billion.

design_detail: wealth tax on the super-rich
quote_original: PWYP Indonesia bersama aliansi Forum Pajak Berkeadilan Indonesia (FPBI) melalui White Paper Reformasi Pajak 2025 menyerukan agar reformasi pajak mencakup tiga pilar utama: (1) perluasan basis pajak progresif, termasuk pajak kekayaan dan pajak karbon.
quote_en: PWYP Indonesia together with the Fair Tax Forum Indonesia (FPBI) alliance through the Tax Reform White Paper 2025 called for tax reform to include three main pillars: (1) expanding the progressive tax base, including a wealth tax and carbon tax.
source_title: Forum Pajak Berkeadilan Indonesia Serukan Reformasi Pajak untuk Keadilan Pajak dan Ekonomi
grading_note: Grade A: institutional co-publication of white paper recommending wealth tax.

design_detail: wealth tax for the super-rich & global minimum wealth tax
quote_original: Oleh karena itu, reformasi perpajakan ke depan tidak boleh hanya berfokus pada mengejar penerimaan, tapi juga harus menyasar ketimpangan melalui kebijakan berbasis keadilan, seperti pajak kekayaan untuk kelompok super kaya dan evaluasi insentif fiskal yang tidak tepat sasaran.
quote_en: Therefore, tax reform in the future must not only focus on chasing revenue, but must also target inequality through justice-based policies, such as a wealth tax for the super-rich and evaluating misdirected fiscal incentives.
source_title: Forum Pajak Berkeadilan Indonesia Serukan Reformasi Pajak untuk Keadilan Pajak dan Ekonomi
grading_note: Grade A: authored white paper and gave presentation specifically urging wealth taxation for the super-rich.

design_detail: progressive 0.5% to 3.5% wealth tax above threshold
quote_original: Sebagai contoh, Yenti mengacu pada kebijakan Spanyol yang menerapkan pajak kekayaan (wealth tax) secara progresif. "Misalnya, kekayaan di atas ambang batas tertentu dikenakan tarif mulai dari 0,5% hingga 3,5%. Indonesia perlu mempertimbangkan instrumen serupa untuk memperluas basis pajak dan meningkatkan keadilan fiskal.
quote_en: For example, Yenti referred to Spain's policy of progressively applying a wealth tax. "For example, wealth above certain thresholds is taxed from 0.5% up to 3.5%. Indonesia needs to consider a similar instrument to broaden the tax base and enhance fiscal justice.
source_title: FPBI Dorong Reformasi Sistem Perpajakan yang Lebih Adil dan Transparan
grading_note: Grade A: explicit proposal specifying a progressive 0.5%-3.5% wealth tax modelled on Spain.

design_detail: wealth tax on high net worth individuals
quote_original: Keenam, revisi kebijakan tarif pajak progresif, termasuk pengenaan pajak kekayaan bagi individu berpenghasilan tinggi dan pengimbangan kenaikan PPN dengan perluasan basis pajak untuk kelompok super kaya, menjadi langkah krusial untuk menciptakan keadilan pajak.
quote_en: Sixth, revising the progressive tax rate policy, including the imposition of a wealth tax on high-income individuals and offsetting VAT increases with expanding the tax base for the super-rich, is a crucial step to creating tax justice.
source_title: FPBI Dorong Reformasi Sistem Perpajakan yang Lebih Adil dan Transparan
grading_note: Grade A: co-author of FPBI white paper recommending wealth tax on high-wealth individuals.

design_detail: wealth tax on the super-rich
quote_original: Keenam, revisi kebijakan tarif pajak progresif, termasuk pengenaan pajak kekayaan bagi individu berpenghasilan tinggi dan pengimbangan kenaikan PPN dengan perluasan basis pajak untuk kelompok super kaya, menjadi langkah krusial untuk menciptakan keadilan pajak.
quote_en: Sixth, revising progressive tax rate policy, including imposing a wealth tax on high-income individuals and expanding the tax base for the super-rich.
source_title: FPBI Dorong Reformasi Sistem Perpajakan yang Lebih Adil dan Transparan
grading_note: Grade A: co-published FPBI white paper recommending wealth taxation.

quote_original: Anggota FPBI diantanya The PRAKARSA, Publish What You Pay (PWYP) Indonesia, Transparency International Indonesia (TII), Lokataru, Seknas FITRA, Celios, Puskaha, Aksi, Indonesia for Global Justice (IGJ), dan Trend Asia.
quote_en: Members of FPBI include The PRAKARSA, Publish What You Pay (PWYP) Indonesia, Transparency International Indonesia (TII), Lokataru, Seknas FITRA, Celios, Puskaha, Aksi, Indonesia for Global Justice (IGJ), and Trend Asia.

design_detail: wealth tax on global and ASEAN ultra-rich & billionaire minimum standards
quote_original: Policy Brief ini membahas tentang pentingnya penerapan pajak kekayaan sebagai solusi untuk mengatasi ketimpangan pajak yang asimetris di Indonesia, Filipina, dan Vietnam. Ketimpangan pendapatan dan kekayaan semakin meningkat di negara-negara tersebut, dengan sebagian besar kekayaan terkonsentrasi pada kelompok pendapatan teratas. Pajak kekayaan dapat membantu pemerataan pendapatan dan melengkapi jenis pajak yang ada, sehingga perlu adanya kebijakan pajak kekayaan yang lebih adil dan merata.
quote_en: This Policy Brief discusses the importance of implementing a wealth tax as a solution to address asymmetric tax inequality in Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vietnam. Income and wealth inequality have intensified in these countries, with the majority of wealth concentrated in the top income brackets. A wealth tax can assist income equalization and complement existing tax types, hence the necessity of a fairer and more equitable wealth tax policy.
source_title: PB 42 – Pajak Kekayaan untuk Mengatasi Distribusi Beban Pajak yang Asimetris
grading_note: Grade A: lead author of Policy Brief 42 proposing global and domestic wealth tax standards.

design_detail: wealth tax integrated with zakat on net wealth
quote_original: Apakah dengan mensinergikan konsep zakat dan pajak kekayaan dapat membantu menyelesaikan masalah pembangunan sosial? Policy Brief edisi 36 "Pajak Kekayaan: Peluang Integrasi Zakat dan Pajak Untuk Mengatasi Ketimpangan Sosial Ekonomi" ini, membahas juga tentang potensi dan tantangan pengumpulan zakat atau pajak kekayaan di Indonesia
quote_en: Can synergizing the concepts of zakat and wealth tax help resolve social development problems? Policy Brief edition 36 "Wealth Tax: Opportunities for Integrating Zakat and Tax to Overcome Socio-Economic Inequality" discusses the potential and challenges of zakat or wealth tax collection in Indonesia.
source_title: PB 36 – Pajak Kekayaan: Peluang Integrasi Zakat dan Pajak Untuk Mengatasi Ketimpangan Sosial Ekonomi
grading_note: Grade A: author of Policy Brief 36 proposing net wealth tax models integrated with zakat.

design_detail: wealth tax on the super rich under UN Tax Convention framework
quote_original: Pajak kekayaan memiliki fungsi untuk memperkecil ketimpangan ... Kerangka UN Tax convention ini yang perlu didorong karena memiliki kerangka sistem pajak global yang berkeadilan termasuk pajak kekayaan.
quote_en: The wealth tax serves the function of reducing inequality ... The UN Tax convention framework needs to be advanced because it provides a just global tax framework including wealth taxation.
source_title: Desakan Pajak Kekayaan Menguat, Diyakini Bisa Memperkecil Ketimpangan
grading_note: Grade B: supports wealth tax (pajak kekayaan) on the super-rich under UN Tax Convention.

design_detail: 1% on wealth > Rp 150B and 2-3% > Rp 1T
quote_original: Selain memilih kepemimpinan baru dengan Yoga Aldo Novensi sebagai Ketua Umum dan Riski Oktara Putra sebagai Sekretaris Jenderal, kongres juga merumuskan Program Pokok Perjuangan LMND yang salah satunya adalah mendorong penerapan pajak kekayaan (wealth tax).
quote_en: In addition to electing new leadership with Yoga Aldo Novensi as General Chair and Riski Oktara Putra as Secretary General, the congress also formulated LMND's Main Struggle Program, one of which is to push for the implementation of a wealth tax.

grading_note: Grade A: formal adoption of wealth tax advocacy as an organizational struggle program at Kongres X.

design_detail: 1% on assets of 50 richest individuals (~Rp 30-50T)
quote_original: Menurut Yoga, pajak kekayaan dapat menjadi solusi konkret dalam menjawab ketimpangan ekonomi yang semakin akut. Pajak ini, jelasnya, bukan sekadar PPh atau PPN, melainkan pungutan atas harta mengendap milik orang-orang super kaya, mulai dari saham, properti mewah, hingga tabungan jumbo. "Dengan skema progresif, misalnya 1% untuk harta di atas Rp150 miliar dan naik jadi 2-3% untuk harta di atas Rp1 triliun, negara bisa memperoleh sumber pendapatan baru tanpa membebani rakyat kecil," ungkapnya.
quote_en: According to Yoga, a wealth tax can be a concrete solution to address acute economic inequality. This tax, he clarified, is not merely income tax (PPh) or VAT (PPN), but a levy on idle assets owned by super-wealthy individuals, ranging from shares, luxury properties, to jumbo savings. "With a progressive scheme, for example 1% on assets above IDR 150 billion rising to 2-3% on assets above IDR 1 trillion, the state can secure a new revenue source without burdening ordinary people," he stated.
source_title: LMND Dorong Pajak Kekayaan Sebagai Jalan Keluar dari Krisis Nasional
grading_note: Grade A: specifies an average 1% wealth tax on assets of the top 50 richest individuals.

design_detail: wealth tax to fund free quality education
quote_original: Konferwil IX yang digelar di Palembang ini mengusung tema sentral yang cukup tajam: "Pendidikan Untuk Rakyat, Pajak Kekayaan Untuk Keadilan: Jalan Mewujudkan Pendidikan Gratis Berkualitas."
quote_en: Regional Conference IX held in Palembang carried a sharp central theme: "Education for the People, Wealth Tax for Justice: The Way to Realize Quality Free Education."

grading_note: Grade A: provincial conference formally adopted wealth taxation as organizational mandate.

quote_en: Through this Konferwil mandate, LMND South Sumatra will consistently encourage the government to effectively allocate a wealth tax to finance free quality education for all people.

grading_note: Grade A: regional leader speech committing organization to campaign for wealth taxation.

quote_en: Therefore, he urged the government to implement a wealth tax. This differs from income tax (PPh), where the tax object of this wealth tax is the wealth of the taxpayer itself.
source_title: Menanti Langkah Berani Prabowo Buru Pajak Orang Kaya Indonesia
grading_note: Grade A: direct quote from tax consultant and former tax auditor explicitly proposing wealth tax.

design_detail: wealth tax on individuals with high assets under consideration by incoming administration
quote_original: Kedua ... penerapan pajak kekayaan atau wealth tax ... Ia menyebut, ada kemungkinan juga untuk mempertimbangkan pajak kekayaan bagi individu dengan aset yang sangat besar
quote_en: Second ... implementation of a wealth tax ... He mentioned that there is also the possibility of considering a wealth tax for individuals with very large assets

Menurut perhitungannya, dengan pajak kekayaan sebesar 2 persen dan pajak karbon Rp100 per kg CO2e, negara berpotensi mendapatkan tambahan penerimaan pajak sebesar Rp152 triliun

According to his calculations, with a 2 percent wealth tax and a carbon tax of Rp100 per kg CO2e, the state could potentially obtain additional tax revenue of Rp152 trillion
source_title: Kenaikan Tarif PPN & Tax Amnesty Sengsarakan Rakyat dan Kurangi Daya Beli
grading_note: Grade A: concrete 2% wealth tax proposal with detailed revenue calculation.

quote_original: Dosen Sekolah Tinggi Hukum Jentera, Bivitri Susanti, menyebut pajak kekayaan sebagai salah satu instrumen penting untuk mengatasi ketimpangan yang bersifat struktural ... Jalan keluar yang satu adalah jelas sekali, tax the rich

quote_original: opsi yang paling realistis dan menjadi keharusan: pajak kekayaan. Dengan menerapkan pajak kekayaan, misalnya dengan tarif 2 persen, maka negara bisa mendapatkan tambahan pendapatan baru. ... design_detail: wealth tax on UHNWIs and conglomerates for fiscal and moral justice
quote_original: Muhammad Anwar, menilai pajak superkaya adalah langkah strategis untuk keadilan fiskal. Ia merujuk Wealth Report 2022 yang mencatat jumlah Ultra High Net Worth Individual (UHNWI) di Indonesia mencapai 1.403 orang, dan diprediksi 1.810 orang pada 2026. ... Anwar juga menekankan aspek moral dalam penerapan pajak konglemerat ini: mereka yang mendapat keuntungan terbesar dari perekonomian memiliki tanggung jawab proporsional untuk mengembalikan manfaatnya ke masyarakat.
quote_en: Muhammad Anwar assessed that taxing the super-rich is a strategic step for fiscal justice. He cited the Wealth Report 2022 recording 1,403 UHNWIs in Indonesia, projected at 1,810 in 2026. ... Anwar also emphasized the moral aspect of taxing conglomerates: those gaining the greatest benefits from the economy have a proportional duty to return benefits to society.
source_title: Betapa Susahnya Tarik Pajak Kekayaan Konglomerat di Indonesia
grading_note: Grade A: expert interview detailing UHNWI growth and moral/fiscal rationale for wealth tax.

design_detail: wealth tax on crazy rich to boost tax ratio and promote equality
quote_original: Pajak kekayaan perlu menjadi pertimbangan pemerintah untuk memacu penerimaan negara dan meningkatkan rasio pajak. ... Nah, pajak kekayaan bisa menjadi cara memacu rasio pajak di tengah peningkatan crazy rich di Indonesia. ... Dengan jumlah crazy rich yang diperkirakan terus meningkat, pajak kekayaan adalah sumber baru penerimaan negara. Ini sekaligus untuk menciptakan asas pemerataan.
quote_en: A wealth tax needs to be considered by the government to spur state revenues and increase the tax ratio. ... A wealth tax can be a way to boost the tax ratio amid the increase in crazy rich in Indonesia. ... With the number of crazy rich projected to grow, a wealth tax is a new source of state revenue, creating equality.
source_title: Pajak Kekayaan
grading_note: Grade A: institutional editorial endorsement from leading financial newspaper.

design_detail: G20 wealth tax and UN Tax Convention demand
quote_original: C20 juga mendorong agar G20 menerapkan pajak kekayaan, pajak layanan digital dan mendukung seruan untuk membentuk Konvensi Pajak PBB dan mereformasi arsitektur utang global di bawah pengawasan PBB
quote_en: C20 also urged the G20 to implement a wealth tax, digital services tax, and supported calls to establish a UN Tax Convention and reform global debt architecture under UN oversight

design_detail: 2% wealth tax on super-rich assets to fund fiscal priorities and curb inequality
quote_original: Nailul Huda ... Selain itu pajak kekayaan berupa 2% pajak bagi aset orang super kaya merupakan hal yang urgen dilakukan untuk menekan ketimpangan, sekaligus memperbesar penerimaan negara
quote_en: Nailul Huda ... In addition, a wealth tax of 2% on the assets of the super-rich is an urgent measure to reduce inequality while expanding state revenues
source_title: CELIOS: 5 Tugas Menkeu Purbaya Kembalikan Kepercayaan Publik

quote_en: Maftuchan outlined the urgent need for a global wealth tax to address inequality and finance the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). ... Therefore, I call for a wealth tax to be included in the UN Tax Convention to address these challenges
source_title: Hadiri Pertemuan Khusus Dewan Ekonomi dan Sosial PBB, PRAKARSA Menyerukan Pajak Kekayaan Masuk dalam Konvensi Pajak
grading_note: Grade A: formal address before the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC) in New York.

design_detail: 1-2% progressive net wealth tax on individuals with net worth over Rp 144 billion administered via SPT
quote_original: Saya Bersama tim peneliti PRAKARSA menawarkan desain pajak kekayaan di Indonesia. Pajak kekayaan dikenakan kepada net worth (total nilai aset dikurangi beban). Wajib pajaknya ialah high-net-worth individual (HNWI) dengan kekayaan bersih melebihi Rp 144 miliar. ... Lalu, tarif yang dikenai progrsif sebesar 1-2 persen dan dilakukan melalui laporan surat pemberitahuan pajak tahunan (SPT).
quote_en: Together with the PRAKARSA research team, I offer a wealth tax design in Indonesia. The wealth tax is levied on net worth (total asset value minus liabilities). The taxpayers are high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) with net wealth exceeding Rp 144 billion. ... The progressive rate is 1-2 percent administered via annual tax returns (SPT).
source_title: Menggagas Pajak Kekayaan Si Superkaya
grading_note: Grade A: signed op-ed in national newspaper outlining comprehensive policy design and administrative mechanism.

design_detail: wealth tax to counter greednomics and plug state budget deficit
quote_original: Manajer Riset dan Pengetahuan The Prakarsa, Roby Rushandie, menilai saat ini merupakan momentum yang tepat bagi pemerintah untuk mulai serius menyiapkan kebijakan tersebut. ... Jadi pajak kekayaan ini bisa jadi salah satu langkah konkret untuk melawan serakahnomics dan menambal defisit APBN
quote_en: Research and Knowledge Manager of The Prakarsa, Roby Rushandie, considered this to be the right momentum for the government to seriously prepare this policy. ... So this wealth tax can be a concrete step to counter greednomics and cover the state budget deficit
source_title: Dorongan Pajak Kekayaan Menguat di Tengah Tekanan Defisit APBN 2026
grading_note: Grade A: research manager interview detailing macro-fiscal urgency amid budget deficit pressures.

design_detail: 2% wealth tax on 50 richest individuals raising Rp 93 trillion per year supported by 89.77% of public
quote_original: berdasarkan hasil survei dalam laporan tersebut, mayoritas responden menyatakan setuju dengan penerapan pajak kekayaan. tingkat persetujuan publik bahkan mendominasi hingga 89,77%, sementara 10,23% sisanya menolak. ... celios juga mengungkap potensi besar penerimaan negara dari pajak kekayaan. dengan skema pajak sebesar 2% terhadap 50 orang terkaya di indonesia, negara diperkirakan bisa meraup hingga rp 93 triliun per tahun.
quote_en: based on the survey results in the report, the majority of respondents agreed with the implementation of a wealth tax. public approval dominated up to 89.77%, while the remaining 10.23% opposed. ... celios also revealed the huge potential of state revenues from a wealth tax: with a 2% scheme on Indonesia 50 richest individuals, the state is projected to reap up to Rp 93 trillion per year.
source_title: Survei Celios: Mayoritas Masyarakat Setuju Penerapan Pajak Kekayaan
grading_note: Grade A: institutional empirical survey report published in leading financial daily.

design_detail: wealth tax on 50 richest asset owners raising Rp 30-50T annually
quote_original: "Angka-angka ini bukan sekadar statistik. Ketimpangan ekstrem inilah yang jadi bahan bakar kemarahan rakyat. Pajak kekayaan bisa jadi jaring pengaman agar krisis sosial tidak meledak lebih jauh," tambah Riski, Sekretaris Jenderal LMND.
quote_en: "These figures are not just statistics. This extreme inequality is the fuel for people's anger. A wealth tax can serve as a safety net so that the social crisis does not explode any further," added Riski, Secretary General of LMND.
source_title: Eksekusi Mandat Kongres, LMND Audiensi dengan DPR Komisi XI: Pajak Kekayaan untuk Hentikan Ledakan Ketimpangan
grading_note: Grade A: Secretary General of LMND explicitly advocates wealth tax in parliamentary hearing with DPR RI Komisi XI.

design_detail: wealth tax to fund free public education
quote_original: Perwakilan Ombudsman RI Wilayah NTB, Dwi Sudarsono, menegaskan bahwa setiap kebijakan perpajakan harus berorientasi pada prinsip keadilan sosial serta transparansi tata kelola. Ia menilai optimalisasi penerimaan negara melalui skema pajak kekayaan dapat menjadi solusi alternatif pembiayaan pendidikan, asalkan disertai pengawasan yang kuat dan akuntabel.
quote_en: Representative of the Indonesian Ombudsman for NTB, Dwi Sudarsono, stressed that every tax policy must be oriented toward social justice principles and governance transparency. He assessed that optimizing state revenue through a wealth tax scheme can serve as an alternative solution for funding education, provided it is accompanied by robust and accountable oversight.
source_title: Dialog Publik Konferwil LMND NTB Kupas Pajak Kekayaan untuk Pendidikan Gratis
grading_note: Grade A: Head of Ombudsman RI NTB Representative Office endorses wealth tax scheme to fund free public education. Review: regraded A to B: endorses a wealth-tax scheme with conditions (strong oversight), no rate.

design_detail: wealth tax as economic redistribution instrument for free education

grading_note: Grade A: Academic and DPD RI expert staff explicitly endorses wealth tax to reduce inequality and fund public services.

design_detail: 2% wealth tax on 50 richest individuals (yielding Rp 93.02T) and 1-2% on > Rp 84B (yielding Rp 142.2T)
quote_original: Negara keras memungut pajak dari konsumsi rakyat, tetapi belum memiliki instrumen yang efektif untuk memajaki akumulasi kekayaan kelompok superkaya. Riset CELIOS dalam Ketimpangan Ekonomi Indonesia 2026: Republik Oligarki menunjukkan bahwa kekayaan 50 orang terkaya mencapai sekitar Rp4.651 triliun. Pengenaan pajak kekayaan sebesar 2 persen terhadap mereka saja berpotensi menghasilkan Rp93,02 triliun per tahun
quote_en: The state aggressively collects taxes on the consumption of the common people, yet lacks effective instruments to tax the accumulated wealth of the super-rich. CELIOS research in Indonesia Economic Inequality 2026 shows that the wealth of the 50 richest individuals reaches around Rp4,651 trillion. Imposing a 2 percent wealth tax on them alone could yield Rp93.02 trillion annually

design_detail: wealth tax on super-rich and windfall extractive profits
quote_original: Pelibatan TNI dan Polri dalam perpajakan harus dihentikan. Pajak harus dikembalikan sebagai fungsi sipil dan instrumen redistribusi, mengurangi beban pajak konsumsi rakyat, memajaki kekayaan orang superkaya, menarik keuntungan berlebih dari bisnis ekstraktif, dan memaksa perusak lingkungan membayar seluruh biaya kerusakannya.
quote_en: The involvement of TNI and Polri in taxation must be stopped. Taxation must be returned to its civilian function and redistributive instrument, reducing consumption taxes on common people, taxing the wealth of the super-rich, extracting excess profits from extractive business, and forcing environmental destroyers to pay all costs of their damage.
source_title: Pajak dalam Bayang-Bayang Aparat, Tajam kepada yang Miskin dan Rentan, Tumpul kepada yang Kaya dan Korporasi
grading_note: Grade A: Broad civil society coalition demands taxing the wealth of the super-rich as a primary redistributive mechanism.

design_detail: progressive wealth tax on 50 richest individuals raising Rp 30-50T per year
quote_original: Kalau rakyat terus diperas lewat PPN dan pajak konsumsi, sementara orang super kaya aman dengan harta triliunan yang mengendap, itu namanya negara pilih kasih. Pajak kekayaan adalah koreksi yang harus segera dijalankan
quote_en: If the people are continuously squeezed through VAT and consumption taxes while the super-rich are safe with trillions in idle assets, that means the state plays favorites. A wealth tax is a correction that must be implemented immediately

design_detail: progressive wealth tax 1-2% on assets > Rp 84B raising Rp 142T
quote_original: pajak kekayaan dikategorikan sebagai pajak progresif karena pembebanannya relatif lebih besar ditanggung oleh kelompok kaya dibanding menekan kelompok miskin dalam pajak regresif.
quote_en: a wealth tax is categorized as a progressive tax because its burden is relatively greater on the wealthy group rather than squeezing the poor in a regressive tax.
